card.name: Interval number after 'every' in dosing
card.fires_on: The number (or its last digit) or the unit word right after 'every' in a dosing schedule, such as 'every 8 hours', 'every 12 hours' or 'every 3 weeks'.

modes.label: Number after every
modes.description: The hours or weeks number in a dosing interval, often the last digit of 12 or 24.

modes.label: Unit after range
modes.description: The word 'hours' closing an interval range after a number.
